caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, round, brown ceramic pot with a wide mouth and two small handles on opposite sides near the rim. The surface of the pot features a smooth, even texture, and the color is a consistent earthy brown, with slight shading to indicate depth and curvature. On the front surface of the pot are two blue outlined decorative illustrations showing birds with outstretched wings perched on branches. There is also a circular blue ink stamp slightly above the decorative illustrations, and the stamp reads "JACOB CAIRE & SON POUGHKEEPSIE." The drawing is on a plain, light-colored background, and the artist's name, "John Tarantino," is written in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
